mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'
# TLS backend

The project's current recorded decision is to use rustls as the TLS backend, chosen for its better defaults. Certificate verification stays on in all builds for any HTTPS connection, and internal hosts use plain HTTP.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
